narrative.details:
The tribe acknowledges station and power through what we wear.  Our vestments are made from the finest of materials, and interwoven with the mojo we use to make us powerful.  Illusionists are no exception; their robes are said to embody the essence of illusion in their look.  Legend states that their ancient robes never looked the same twice.

I will give you an illusionist's robe, adventurer... but earn your place of reverence among the tribe first!  Bring me the Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub!
narrative.objectives: Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Kossack.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.
narrative.offerRewardText: At last, someone worthy to wear the illusionist's robe!  Your success in Zul'Gurub has assured your reverences amongst the tribe for ages to come.  Wear it with pride, adventurer!
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you returned with the Paragons of Power we need?  I know it will not be easy... but I have long predicted an outsider would come to aid us in our fight against Hakkar.  Let it be you, I say!
